title: Isandro and the Autopsy
author: Silas Montrose
blurb: Felix Sterling, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
